arms.label: N-0 (null, both host and impostors dosed)

note: The registered prediction named the impostor sea as the carrier (E1-imp >= 0.030) and the host as inert (E1-host <= 0.012). The measurement inverts this: E1-imp is consistent with zero and E1-host carries the only nonzero split-arm bias -- and neither arm, nor their sum, reproduces N-0. The split is informative about non-additivity, not about which half 'carries' the effect.
